issue: buyAssist ignored enabled_current; archived brace_door/temperature_hold could spend reserve and expose effects, and shutter could change service mode.
fix: Require enabled_current === true before any reserve spend, receipt or effect; changeServiceMode returns this rejection before cancelling checkout or changing mode.
coverage: disabled assists preserve all state and expose no effect
rejected shutter preserves active checkout, original patience and completion time
enabled snapshot/side_light/route_light retain price and duration
existing service/stock transactions and zero-reserve F13 behavior remain covered
historical_fixture: Two archived shutter timer/exit checks use a clearly labelled independent enabled clone. Current brace_door remains false and is asserted unchanged.
scope: Headless current-assist admission and existing store-contract scenarios; not full AI, rendering, mobile usability, new facility candidates, or seven-night gameplay validation.
standalone_html_note: The independent two-monster HTML bundles seven modules and does not include store_core_v05.mjs. Its separate old items metadata drift is recorded by the root audit/build report; this guard fix is not claimed to be integrated into that HTML.
